## Retrieval protocol used by X-Pool (and most CLIP-based work)

| split | videos | text-video pairs | origin (official 2016 split, by id range) |
|---|---|---|---|
| train 9k (main) | 9,000 | 180,000 | {'train': 6513, 'validate': 497, 'test': 1990} |
| train 7k (alt.) | 7,010 | 140,200 | {'train': 6513, 'validate': 497} |
| test 1k-A | 1,000 | 1,000 (1 query/video) | {'test': 1000} |

- train9k ∩ test1k-A = 0 videos; videos unused by the 9k protocol = 0
- 1k-A queries that are verbatim MSR-VTT captions of their video: 965/1000
- steps/epoch at batch 32 (9k): 5,625 → 5 epochs = 28,125 steps
- **No validation split exists in this protocol**: the official code selects `model_best.pth` on the 1k-A test set (see docs/BASELINE_XPOOL.md).
